tasks.title: Create Python tooling config files and dev requirements
tasks.description: Create pyproject.toml at repo root with [tool.black], [tool.mypy], [tool.pytest.ini_options], and [tool.coverage.*] sections. Create .flake8 at repo root with max-line-length=88, extend-ignore=E203,W503, per-file-ignores for __init__.py:F401. Create requirements-dev.txt with black, flake8, mypy, pytest, pytest-cov. Update requirements.txt to remove commented dev deps and add a reference comment pointing to requirements-dev.txt. Install dev deps with pip install -r requirements-dev.txt.
tasks.definition_of_done: All 3 new files exist with correct content. pip install -r requirements-dev.txt succeeds. black, flake8, mypy, and pytest are importable.

tasks.title: Run black auto-format on all Python files
tasks.description: Run 'black src/ install/' to auto-format all Python files. Verify with 'black --check src/ install/' exiting 0. Do NOT fix flake8 or mypy issues in this task — only black formatting.
tasks.definition_of_done: 'python -m black --check src/ install/' exits 0 with no reformatting needed.

tasks.title: Fix all flake8 warnings in src/ and install/
tasks.description: Run 'flake8 src/ install/' and fix all warnings. Common fixes: unused imports, missing whitespace, undefined names, bare excepts. Use the .flake8 config created in P1-T1. Do NOT change runtime behavior — only lint fixes (imports, whitespace, type annotations, lint pragmas).
tasks.definition_of_done: 'python -m flake8 src/ install/' exits 0 with zero warnings.

tasks.title: Fix all mypy errors in src/ and install/
tasks.description: Run 'mypy src/ install/' and fix all errors. Use the [tool.mypy] config from pyproject.toml (ignore_missing_imports=true, check_untyped_defs=true). Use targeted '# type: ignore[code]' comments with specific error codes where needed — never bare '# type: ignore'. Do NOT change runtime behavior.
tasks.definition_of_done: 'python -m mypy src/ install/' exits 0 with zero errors.

tasks.title: Add TOML validation with taplo and fix any issues
tasks.description: Validate all .toml files in the repo using 'npx @taplo/cli check' or 'npx @taplo/cli fmt --check'. Fix any formatting issues in config/*.toml and pyproject.toml. The 9 config TOML files plus pyproject.toml are the targets.
tasks.definition_of_done: 'npx @taplo/cli check **/*.toml' (or equivalent) exits 0 with zero errors.

tasks.title: Add shellcheck validation and fix shell script issues
tasks.description: Run shellcheck against all .sh files: bin/unix/take_screenshot.sh, setup.sh, src/arcade_station/core/linux/arcade_station_start.sh, src/arcade_station/core/macos/arcade_station_start.sh. Fix all warnings. Use targeted '# shellcheck disable=SCXXXX' directives with comments where intentional patterns are flagged. Exclude .claude/hooks/session-start.sh (agent infrastructure).

tasks.title: Add PSScriptAnalyzer validation and fix PowerShell script issues
tasks.description: If pwsh is available, run PSScriptAnalyzer against all .ps1 and .psm1 files: install_logic.ps1 (repo root), src/arcade_station/core/windows/*.ps1, src/arcade_station/core/windows/core_functions.psm1. Fix all warnings/errors. If pwsh is not available, document the skip and the commands needed to run manually.
tasks.definition_of_done: PSScriptAnalyzer reports zero warnings/errors on all PowerShell files, or a documented note explains pwsh unavailability with manual run instructions.

tasks.title: Add Linux-compatible VS Code .venv activation task
tasks.description: Add a new task to .vscode/tasks.json labeled 'Activate .venv (Linux)' with command 'source ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/activate', type shell, reveal always, panel shared, detail 'Activates the virtual environment on Linux/macOS'.
tasks.definition_of_done: .vscode/tasks.json contains both the existing Windows 'Activate .venv' task and the new Linux-compatible task.

tasks.title: Fix markdownlint errors in all 7 failing markdown files
tasks.description: Fix all 39 markdownlint errors across: README.md, PLAN.MD, THANKS.md, examples/DDR.md, examples/LAPTOP.md, src/arcade_station/core/windows/README_ICLOUD.md, src/pegasus-fe/themes/micro/README.md. Common fixes: heading levels, blank lines, trailing whitespace, list formatting, fenced code blocks. Do NOT change the meaning or content of any documentation.
tasks.definition_of_done: 'npx markdownlint-cli2 README.md PLAN.MD THANKS.md examples/DDR.md examples/LAPTOP.md src/arcade_station/core/windows/README_ICLOUD.md src/pegasus-fe/themes/micro/README.md' exits 0.

tasks.title: Remove temporary markdownlint ignore entries
tasks.description: Edit .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc to remove all temporary file-level ignores for the 7 pre-existing files. Keep the .state/inbox/*.md ignore (those are .gitignored agent infrastructure files). Verify the full markdownlint suite passes.
tasks.definition_of_done: 'npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"' exits 0. .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc contains no ignore entries for any of the 7 previously-failing files.

tasks.title: Provision Python 3.12 and recreate virtual environment
tasks.description: Install Python 3.12 on the dev environment (Debian 12) using pyenv or deadsnakes PPA. Recreate the .venv using Python 3.12. Reinstall requirements.txt and requirements-dev.txt. Verify all tools (black, flake8, mypy, pytest) work under 3.12. Confirm the black Python 3.12 target-version warning is gone from pre-commit hooks.
tasks.definition_of_done: python --version inside .venv reports 3.12.x. All dev tools run without version warnings. Pre-commit hook runs clean with no Python version mismatch warning.

tasks.title: Create test directory structure and pytest configuration
tasks.description: Create tests/__init__.py (empty), tests/conftest.py (with toml_config_dir fixture using tmp_path and monkeypatch), tests/unit/__init__.py (empty). Verify pyproject.toml already has [tool.pytest.ini_options] from P1-T1. Verify [tool.coverage.*] sections exist in pyproject.toml. Run 'python -m pytest --collect-only' to confirm pytest discovers the test directory.
tasks.definition_of_done: tests/ directory exists with conftest.py and unit/ subdirectory. 'python -m pytest --collect-only' runs without error (may find 0 tests, which is fine at this stage).

tasks.title: Write unit tests for core_functions.py pure/config functions
tasks.description: Create tests/unit/test_core_functions.py with unit tests for: (1) determine_operating_system — mock platform.system() for Windows/Linux/Darwin, (2) convert_path_for_platform — parametrize with Windows/Unix paths plus None/empty edge cases, (3) load_toml_config — use tmp_path fixture with valid TOML, test FileNotFoundError for missing file, test TOMLDecodeError for invalid TOML, (4) load_key_mappings_from_toml — fixture with TOML containing [key_mappings], test empty mappings, (5) load_installed_games/load_game_config/load_mame_config — mock load_toml_config to verify correct TOML filename, (6) log_message — capture output, verify timestamp format and prefix. All tests must follow Google-style docstrings. Use unittest.mock.patch for IO-dependent functions. Do NOT refactor core_functions.py.
tasks.definition_of_done: 'python -m pytest tests/unit/test_core_functions.py -v' exits 0 with all tests passing. Each testable function has at least one test per distinct code path. Test suite completes in under 30 seconds. 'python -m pytest --cov=src/arcade_station' produces a coverage report without error.
